symptom: On a widget with two datasources (DatagridDropdownFilter's linkedDs + refOptions), a dependent attribute binds to whichever datasource mapping ran LAST, not to the one the widget declares it belongs to
cause: The widget template states the link per property (widget.xml `dataSource="..."` -> PropertyTypeIDEntry.DataSourceProperty) and the loader reads it, but sdk/pages re-declared PropertyTypeIDEntry as a SECOND struct of the same shape, so every hop went through a hand-written field copy (convertPropTypeIDs + an inline one in BuildFilterWidget) that omitted the field. The engine then had only pageBuilder.entityContext, which holds one entity
insight: A hand-written copy between two spellings of one type can only LOSE fields, and loses them silently -- nothing failed, the engine just never learned the link and reconstructed it from .def.json mapping order. Look for the vendor's own answer before inventing a convention: `GetTemplateFullBSON` already returned every DataSourceProperty link for ComboBox and DropdownFilter, and a 6-line test printing them settled the design. `GetTemplateBSON` does NOT populate ValueType or DataSourceProperty -- probing with it shows empty for everything and looks like the data is absent
